messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a pentest dry-run next Tue 09:00-13:00 PT. We'll fold an IR sim into the window to validate evidence handoff, KMS access, and RBAC changes. Need to lock access windows and the roles that get granted. @jonathan can you confirm ephemeral role TTLs and log export cadence?

jonathan: I can do TTLs. Current ephemeral role expiry is 1h by default for assessor roles; we can extend to 4h for the dry-run. Log export: we can stream CloudTrail->S3 with 15m delivery and also ship to our SIEM in near-real-time. Do we want presigned artifacts or a read-only S3 role?

maria: Prefer presigned for assessor uploads (simpler for external testers) and a read-only role for evidence pull by internal triage. Need audit trail for both. :white_check_mark:

ryan: For the IR sim, oncall will trigger an incident with the incident-bot at 09:30, mark as "pentest-dryrun-IR" so SRE knows it's a sim. We'll attach the evidence bundle to the incident. Make sure the upload path matches the bucket policy.

tara: I'll own evidence packaging and metadata. Plan: tar + sha256sum, put manifest.json with fields: assessment_id, timestamp, uploader, signed_by. We'll also include a notes.txt with any ephemeral creds used.

akhtar: KMS notes: use a dedicated asymmetric key for signing evidence manifests and a symmetric key for encrypting artifacts at rest. Key policy should allow kms:Decrypt for the read-only triage role and kms:Sign for the packaging service. For assessors we grant kms:Encrypt only via a condition on aws:PrincipalTag:Assessor=true. Example snippet (high level):
```
Condition: {"StringEquals": {"aws:PrincipalTag/Assessor": "true"}}
```
We should avoid granting broad Decrypt to assessor principals.

jonathan: For presigned upload example:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-evidence/ACME-dryrun.tar.gz --expires-in 7200
```
I'll also create a short-lived IAM role for internal triage with MFA-required session tags.

maria: Who's available to run a dry-run checklist Fri afternoon? Need: create bucket & policy, KMS key with staged policy, pre-create assessor identities, schedule incident-bot trigger, and run an end-to-end evidence upload + triage pull.

ryan: I can help Fri 3pm PT. I'll test incident-bot trigger and the triage role pull.

tara: I'll do packaging at 2:30pm PT and generate signed manifest.

akhtar: I'll stage the KMS keys and update policies by noon Fri, will DM proof of policy to the thread.

jonathan: I'll stand up the short-lived roles and presign workflows. I'll post the bucket name and presign command once done.

pentest-bot: Reminder: retention window for dry-run evidence is 14 days. Automated cleanup scheduled + alert 48h before delete.

maria: Great. After the dry-run we'll collect a short blameless retro and iterate on the runbook. Also planning a retest window two weeks after fixes are merged — aim to lock dates in the next sync. Thanks everyone.
